topics.title: Family Feud and Car Sales
topics.summary: Two families remain embroiled in a decades-long feud, complicated by personal relationships and legal battles, while discussing a man who wiped out his family before adopting a new identity. Amidst this turmoil, the hosts briefly discuss an unrelated case involving a man accused of murder and then promote E&B discount marine stores’ spring fitting out sale offering various boating supplies.

topics.title: Family Secrets and Prison Time
topics.summary: A troubled family man’s past is revealed, including religious extremism, infidelity, attempted murder, drug possession, and his wife's syphilis diagnosis. The story includes details of the son’s witchcraft beliefs and attempts by the father to control his family through imprisonment and constant potty checks, alongside revelations about a reverend’s opinions on criminal justice.

topics.title: Nixon’s Artificial Eyes and Cardiac Arrest
topics.summary: Howard discusses Richard Nixon undergoing two unusual surgeries – artificial eyeballs placed by Barbara Bush and treatment for an arrhythmia similar to that which caused Hank Gathers’ death. Calls inquire about obtaining the procedures, with commentary on Nixon's lack of athletic background before his cardiac episode.”}  çocuğes. 1-2 sentences, at most 55 words.

topics.title: Strange Phone Calls and Bus Fears
topics.summary: Several callers share unsettling experiences including anxieties about buses, bizarre phone calls involving NASA, a near-strangling incident with an 11-year-old boy following instructions from a fake doctor, and discussions of Sam’s influence on Leslie. The hosts engage in tangential conversations regarding Paul Newman's acting style and other unrelated anecdotes.”}hanks to the transcript provided.

topics.title: Border Bureaucracy and a Dog
topics.summary: A touring rock group’s attempt to cross into Canada is repeatedly thwarted by confusing border officials. The crew encounters an obsessive customs dog, a falsely accused bus driver arrested for smuggling empty bags, and ultimately the operation halts due to a seemingly pointless search, culminating in a bizarre arrest of the bus driver.

topics.title: Portland Bus Trip & Equipment Chaos
topics.summary: FBI agents take bus driver Steve Longo into custody after he drives a company bus to Portland, Oregon. The conversation shifts to an excessive amount of equipment purchases – including a guitar with 400 sounds and a computer with 75 – leading to discussions about potential drug use.
